directive.full_text_location: User-delivered conversation attachment. This record is a structured design/state summary, not a full-text copy.
directive.start_requirement: Work must verify the attached full directive hash, append the complete text to a new path, actual-GET verify it, and precommit the analysis before any new outcome join. Do not execute unspecified steps from this summary alone.

reuse_first.policy: Reuse existing canonical scores, references, certificates and saved V5 ledgers. Do not rerun the R1 OFF/D/DR market paths.

corrections_to_previous_conversation.model_vs_policy: Frozen head scores and original-cohort metrics can be preserved; a new combined selection rule is not thereby certified noninferior.
corrections_to_previous_conversation.no_blend_not_a_guarantee: AND/OR/Pareto/priority/tie-break can also change selected cohorts and returns.
corrections_to_previous_conversation.rank_conflict: Opposite strict rankings on a candidate pair cannot both be preserved by one total order. Preserve separate expert views and report conflicts.
corrections_to_previous_conversation.mask_change: AUC on V5 funded150 need not equal original common1028 AUC. A difference alone is not artifact corruption.
corrections_to_previous_conversation.raw_vs_percentile: Block-specific empirical percentile can create ties and cross-block reordering. It is not interchangeable with frozen raw pP ranking.
corrections_to_previous_conversation.loser_meaning: Potential Weak is not realized loss. U5/U10 can coexist with realized loss; MRET is relative monetization, not P(net>0).
corrections_to_previous_conversation.replacement: Forced sale or partial sale to replace a current holding violates permanently frozen EXIT and is excluded.
corrections_to_previous_conversation.MRET_incrementality: Keep numeric certification unchanged; add evaluation-only signed potential-score controls to test whether MRET supplies additional information rather than merely reversed potential ordering.

cohorts: all legacy rank-pass and raw terminal reasons
diagnostic_contract.head_packet: raw_score/model_hash/reference_hash/rational_rank/prediction_origin/available; no future outcomes or protected membership
diagnostic_contract.rank: r=(1+count(train_score<current_score))/(N+1); strict LOW below1/2; exact1/2 HIGH; raw-median equality is irrelevant
diagnostic_contract.risk_FLAG_diagnostics: -q2/-q3/-mP Top20% and Top30%, K=ceil(fraction*known_N), same-budget comparisons; diagnostic-only, not runtime thresholds
diagnostic_contract.pair_and_head_ties: Explicit; no epsilon-chosen reordering; AUC(-s)=1-AUC(s) for identical mask/labels and half-credit ties

role_screens_are_design_only.Winner: C3 pP U5 and U10 AUC CI lower>.5
role_screens_are_design_only.Medium_plus: C3 q3 U3 AUC CI lower>.5
role_screens_are_design_only.MRET_absolute_loss_defense: C2 mP net>0 AUC CI lower>.5 and delta CI lower>0 against each fixed signed/unsigned potential control
role_screens_are_design_only.coverage_and_validity: Both classes, complete scoped score coverage, identity/as-of PASS, at least1900 valid bootstrap replicates; otherwise partial/INCONCLUSIVE
role_screens_are_design_only.not_claimed: Not future noninferiority, no-loss guarantee, or confirmatory OOS

legal_channels.CH5_CH6: Cash/lot and rank/other rejections separately; no new allocation or band policy
